SQL analytics¶

The repository contains SQL examples for Athena-style analysis.

Model efficiency¶

1SELECT model, total_distance_km,
2total_battery_consumed, overall_efficiency
3FROM ev_model_efficiency
4ORDER BY overall_efficiency DESC;

Region efficiency¶

1SELECT region, total_distance_km,
2total_battery_consumed, overall_efficiency
3FROM ev_region_efficiency
4ORDER BY overall_efficiency DESC;

Range trend¶

1SELECT date, avg_estimated_range_km,
2avg_battery_percent
3FROM ev_range_trend
4ORDER BY date;

Vehicle efficiency¶

1SELECT vehicle_id, model, region,
2total_distance_km, overall_efficiency
3FROM ev_vehicle_efficiency
4ORDER BY overall_efficiency DESC;

Top and bottom vehicles¶

 1-- TOP 5
 2SELECT vehicle_id, model, region, overall_efficiency
 3FROM ev_vehicle_efficiency
 4ORDER BY overall_efficiency DESC
 5LIMIT 5;
 6
 7-- BOTTOM 5
 8SELECT vehicle_id, model, region, overall_efficiency
 9FROM ev_vehicle_efficiency
10ORDER BY overall_efficiency ASC
11LIMIT 5;
